description: Geocode an address to coordinates using Radar (forward geocoding). Returns the best-match formatted address with latitude/longitude. Example: radar_geocode({ query: "841 Broadway, New York, NY", _apiKey: "prj_live_sk_..." })

_apiKey.description: Radar API key (get one free at radar.com)

query.description: Full address to geocode, e.g. "841 Broadway, New York, NY 10003"

name: radar_geocode
title: Radar Geocode
